title: Early-return followed by local writes then terminal return — pass 22
sourceUrl: internal: Tier 4.3 pass 22 tail-Ops in canonicalizer
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Function body has early return followed by side-effect local writes and a terminal return: `if s='1' then return x; end if; tmp := z; return tmp;`. Pass 22 extends the canonicalizer to fold trailing Ops into the synthesised else branch's task list — combined with pass-20's `[Op*, Return]` branch-shape relaxation, the whole body lowers to a 2-arm MUX cascade.
